name: Answer-Set Consistency Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset designed to evaluate answer-set inconsistency in large language models by testing their ability to maintain set-theoretic relations (equivalence, disjointness, containment) across enumeration questions.
reputation: A niche academic benchmark with limited adoption outside the original line of work on answer-set inconsistency in LLMs.
notes: Proposes metrics to quantify answer-set inconsistency; includes mitigation strategies prompting LLMs to reason about relations before answering.
